subject: Coord: two-part MSA redline + onboarding demo for HelioHealth
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@heliohealth.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com
Cc: miguel.torres@heliohealth.com
Date: 2027-01-10T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Initial: two sessions request — MSA redline + tech demo

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Procurement and legal at HelioHealth reviewed the draft MSA and would like to run a short redline call with Redwood legal before we proceed to the technical onboarding demo.

Proposal: two sessions —
- Session A (30m): MSA redline walk, identify must-fix items and outstanding open points (legal + procurement)
- Session B (45m): Technical onboarding & demo for our platform team (engineering + SRE)

Can your team run these as separate blocks the same week? Preferably Session A early in the week so legal sign-off can unblock the demo. Attached is our annotated MSA (Helio_MSA_v3_redline.pdf) and a draft agenda (Onboarding-Agenda.docx).

Availability window: Jan 11–15, mornings PST preferred.

Alicia Gomez
Senior Procurement Manager
HelioHealth

Attachments: Helio_MSA_v3_redline.pdf (pdf), Onboarding-Agenda.docx (docx)

From: tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@heliohealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-01-11T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial: two sessions request — MSA redline + tech demo

Hi Alicia — thanks for the materials, got them.

We can definitely split this into two focused sessions. Quick proposal from our side (all times PST):
- Session A (MSA redline): Tue Jan 12, 10:00–10:30am PST — Redwood legal (Laura) + Helio legal/procurement.
- Session B (Technical demo & onboarding): Wed Jan 13, 9:00–9:45am PST — our Solutions Engineer + your engineering team.

Laura, can you join the redline call on Tue? Marissa, I flagged the demo so the SE can prep the short walkthrough and the environment checklist.

If those slots don't work, happy to propose an alternate pair. I'll pencil these in tentatively once you confirm. Also, Alicia — can you confirm whether your CISO or security reviewer needs to be on the demo? If so, we can add a 15m pre-brief.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Strategic Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
